usage: The word '音箱' (jam1 soeng1) is used as a noun to refer to a speaker device.
'音箱' can be the subject or object in a sentence, e.g., '我買咗個新音箱' (I bought a new speaker).
You can describe the type or quality of a speaker by adding adjectives before '音箱'.
'音箱' often appears with verbs like '開' (turn on) and '關' (turn off).
